title: Lauren Conrad bought a $1.35M Beverly Hills penthouse, rebuilt it, sold it for $2.8M
summary_full: Lauren Conrad, known for The Hills, sold her renovated Beverly Hills penthouse for $2.8 million. She initially purchased the property for $1.35 million four years earlier. After extensive renovations, she transformed the space into a modern home with high-end finishes. The penthouse includes a large open-plan living area, multiple bedrooms, and outdoor terraces. Conrad's real estate ventures in Southern California continue to show significant financial returns.
